messages:
anne (pm): Quick thread: customers asking for region-scoped pinning during launch window. Need to decide gating, billing semantics, TTL, and benchmark requirements before we commit infra.

zoe (product): Two asks from enterprise pilots: 1) pin model 3.2 in us-west and eu-central for 60 days; 2) guarantee p99 <= 220ms on pinned traffic. They prefer a shorter canary (1 week) if we can run their prompt-sets.

matt (eng-runtime): Technical note: pinned replicas must be allocated per-region to meet local p99. That means reserved GPUs per tenant-region unless we do multi-tenant pooling. Reserved per-tenant ramps up cost and complicates autoscaler policies.

ravi (eng-ml): From QA: model 3.2-vanilla p99=230ms on V100, quantized q4_0 p99=160ms but we saw BLEU-like drop on long-context summarization. We can run customer prompts through both variants to measure delta. Need seed & truncation policy.

sophia (customer-success): Customers will accept quantized if their key flows stay within 1.5% accuracy delta. They'll only sign LOA if we show side-by-side eval and run a 1-week pilot with live traffic <5% of their users.

infra-bot: Quota check: us-west has spare capacity for two small pinned replicas; eu-central requires approval for additional allocation.

billing-bot: Reminder: pinned-resources billing is pro-rated daily and flagged as "pin_fee" + usage. Confirm whether trial pilots get pin fee waived.

anne (pm): Proposal A (conservative): Require per-customer prompt-set pass with accuracy delta <=1.5% on quantized variant OR p99 <= 220ms on full-precision; TTL for pins = 60d with auto-unpin 7d prior notification. Canary window = 7d at 5% traffic.

Proposal B (optimize-cost): Allow pooled regional pins (multi-tenant) with SLA caveat; customer can opt into dedicated pin for +pin_fee. TTL = 90d opt-in or renew. Canary window = 14d at 10% traffic.

matt (eng-runtime): Pooling reduces infra footprint but requires stronger isolation controls and routing tweaks. Also need emergency unpin policy: auto-unpin if p99 > threshold for 30m or error rate spike >3x baseline.

ravi (eng-ml): Eval harness we will use: run_eval --model {variant} --prompts {customer_prompts.json} --seed 42 --truncation policy=right --metrics top1,bleu,latency --report csv. I'll produce results within 48h for the two pilot customers.

sophia (customer-success): I'll collect customer prompt sets and ask for LOA templates. Also confirm acceptance criteria: if both customers fail quantized pass but meet p99 on FP, will they accept FP for launch?

zoe (product): Narrowing decisions needed by Friday: which proposal, TTL, billing waiver for pilots, and exact gating numbers. My leaning: Proposal A for GA to keep SLAs tight; consider pooling as an opt-in later. Thoughts?

matt (eng-runtime): +1 Proposal A for GA. Less complexity at launch. We can prototype pooling in parallel.

ravi (eng-ml): Agree on A. I'll aim for stricter eval threshold 1.2% delta. If customers request relaxed threshold, escalate.

billing-bot: Note: Pilot pin fee waiver requires finance approval. Sophia, looping in finance is needed.

sophia (customer-success): Will ping finance and send LOA drafts. Also scheduling: customers want start window next Wed. Is that feasible?

anne (pm): Timeline check: if infra approves eu-central quota by Tue, and we have eval results Mon, we can start Wed. Otherwise push 1 week.

infra-bot: eu-central approval pending. ETA 48h if no other priority.

zoe (product): OK action items:
- ravi: run evals and upload CSV by Mon EOD (owner: ravi)
- matt + infra: confirm eu-central quota by Tue (owner: matt + infra)
- sophia: send LOA + finance loop for pin fee waiver (owner: sophia)
- anne: draft GA pin runbook and emergency unpin policy (owner: anne)

anne (pm): If all green, we'll ship GA pin path with TTL=60d, 7d notification, and the gating checklist described. If any blocker, fallback is to offer pooled pin trial or global fallback to non-pinned variant.

zoe (product): Thanks all. Please update this thread with status updates. I'll prep comms for customers once we have eval CSVs.
